edits.text:
SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT — NONBINDING DISCUSSION DRAFT
This draft records proposed terms for discussion only. Neither party is obliged to proceed unless and until definitive documentation has been agreed, approved and executed. No provision of this draft is intended to be legally binding, and any existing binding confidentiality agreement remains unaffected.

1. Purchase Price. Subject to Seller and Buyer approval, satisfactory diligence and definitive documentation, the proposed purchase price for the Shares is USD 35,000,000 on a cash-free, debt-free basis, assuming delivery of normalized working capital. The definitive agreement shall specify the working-capital target, accounting principles, definitions of cash, debt and transaction expenses, and customary closing adjustments, without double counting. It shall provide for an estimated closing statement, a post-closing true-up, review and objection periods, and resolution of accounting disputes by an independent accountant.

2. Closing and Conditions. The parties shall work toward an expedited closing, targeting 30 days after signing where practicable, but not as an unconditional deadline. Closing shall be subject to completion of an agreed diligence process satisfactory to the Buyer, required corporate and regulatory approvals and third-party consents, accuracy of the Seller’s representations subject to agreed materiality standards, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, absence of any legal restraint, and other mutually agreed customary conditions. The definitive agreement shall specify the scope and timing of diligence, satisfaction or waiver of conditions, an agreed outside date and closing procedures. Completion mechanics shall include payment of the adjusted price, delivery of duly executed share transfers and evidence of title, release of agreed security interests, debt repayment arrangements where applicable, and customary corporate records, certificates and resignations.

3. Representations, Covenants and Remedies. The definitive agreement shall include customary Seller representations addressing title to the Shares, authority and enforceability, capitalization, financial statements, undisclosed liabilities, taxes, material contracts, litigation, legal compliance, employees and benefits, intellectual property, assets, and other matters appropriate to the business. These representations shall be subject to agreed disclosure schedules, materiality and knowledge qualifications and other negotiated limitations. The Buyer shall provide customary representations concerning authority, enforceability and capacity to fund completion. Pending closing, the Seller shall procure operation of the business in the ordinary course, preservation of the business and records, reasonable diligence access subject to confidentiality and privilege safeguards, and agreed restrictions on extraordinary actions, with consent requirements and exceptions to be negotiated. The definitive agreement shall provide for indemnification for agreed breaches and specified matters, supported by an escrow or holdback whose amount, duration and release mechanics remain to be agreed. Survival periods, baskets, caps, claims procedures, mitigation, exclusions of double recovery and treatment of fraud shall be expressly negotiated. Termination rights shall include mutual agreement, failure to close by the agreed outside date, an uncured material breach following an agreed cure period, and a final legal prohibition, with restrictions on termination by a party whose breach caused the relevant failure and preservation of accrued rights as agreed.

4. Confidentiality. The definitive agreement shall require the parties to keep the transaction terms and nonpublic information confidential, subject to customary exceptions for information lawfully public or independently obtained without breach. Permitted disclosures shall include disclosures on a need-to-know basis to professional advisers and actual or prospective financing sources subject to applicable professional duties or appropriate confidentiality obligations, and disclosures required by law, regulation or competent authority. For compelled disclosures, the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt notice, cooperate reasonably in seeking protective treatment and disclose only what is legally required. Public announcements shall require prior agreement except where legally required. Pending definitive documentation, any existing binding confidentiality agreement shall continue to govern.

Specify a diligence work plan and access arrangements, a mutually agreed outside date and Buyer-controlled waiver of conditions benefiting Buyer. Require comprehensive Seller representations and disclosure schedules, ordinary-course covenants and consent rights over material departures. Propose a 10% indemnity escrow for 18 months, with timely notified claims reserved; general representation survival of 18 months and a 20% general cap, with separate treatment for title, authority, capitalization, taxes, identified risks and fraud. receiver.message_back:
Counsel,

Thank you for the revised draft. The expanded framework is constructive. For clarity, Buyer has not accepted USD 35,000,000 or any other transaction term.

Buyer proposes USD 30,000,000 on the stated cash-free, debt-free basis with normalized working capital, subject to Buyer approval, satisfactory diligence and agreement and execution of definitive documentation. This counterproposal reflects the outstanding diligence and allocation of transaction risk; it is not a binding commitment.

Please revise the draft to reflect that price basis and the following proposals:

• Agree the working-capital target, accounting policies and definitions of debt, cash and transaction expenses following financial diligence. Include an estimated closing statement, post-closing true-up and independent-accountant resolution of accounting disputes, without double counting.
• Set an agreed diligence work plan, prompt access to the necessary records and management, and a realistic outside date. The 30-day target must remain indicative, not an obligation to close before conditions are satisfied or waived by the party entitled to their benefit.
• Include comprehensive Seller representations and disclosure schedules, with qualifications negotiated individually, together with ordinary-course protections and Buyer consent rights over material departures.
• As an opening remedies proposal, provide a 10% price escrow for 18 months, 18-month general representation survival and a 20% general indemnity cap. Timely notified unresolved claims should remain reserved. Fundamental representations, taxes, identified diligence risks and fraud require separately agreed protections and should not automatically fall within general limitations. Any basket remains to be agreed.
• Require satisfactory evidence of share title, repayment of applicable debt, release of security and delivery of all agreed completion documents against payment.

Please confirm whether Seller is prepared to proceed on this revised price basis and provide its response on the remaining commercial terms. All proposals remain nonbinding and subject to contract, and existing binding confidentiality obligations remain unaffected.
